name: TSV994IPT
title: TSV991, TSV992, TSV994 and A versions: rail-to-rail input/output 20 MHz GBP op amps, 2.5 V to 5.5 V
summary: Single (TSV991), dual (TSV992) and quad (TSV994) op amps for 2.5 V to 5.5 V supplies, with inputs and outputs that reach both rails, 20 MHz gain bandwidth and 10 V/µs slew at about 0.8 mA per channel. They are stable only at gains of 4 and above, or -3 inverting. Input bias current is 1 pA typical; the A versions hold offset to 1.5 mV max at 25 °C. TSV994IPT is the quad standard-offset part in TSSOP14 on tape and reel, rated -40 °C to 125 °C.

operation.text: TSV991 is the single, TSV992 the dual and TSV994 the quad. The A versions (TSV991A, TSV992A, TSV994A) have the tighter offset: 1.5 mV max at 25 °C and 3 mV over temperature, against 4.5 mV and 7.5 mV. TSV911, TSV912 and TSV914 (and their A versions) are the related amplifiers that are stable at unity gain.

The amplifier is not stable at unity gain. Run it at a closed-loop gain of at least 4 non-inverting or -3 inverting (45 ° phase margin with Rf = 10 kΩ, RL = 2 kΩ, CL = 100 pF). The amplifiers are made for resistive loads above 2 kΩ.

A follower works when a small resistor sits in series with the output. The series resistor vs. capacitive load graph gives the smallest value for each load capacitance; with at least that value the peaking stays at 2.3 dB or less, and below it the peaking exceeds 2.3 dB. ST recommends confirming the chosen value on the bench and with the simulation model.

A capacitor across the feedback resistor improves stability and cuts the peaking with a capacitive load. In an inverting stage of gain -2 (Rf = 100 kΩ, Rg = 50 kΩ) a 470 fF feedback capacitor brings the peaking from about 11 dB to about 1.2 dB at 10 pF load.
Place a 10 nF decoupling capacitor at each supply pin, as close to the pin as possible.

Both inputs work from 0.1 V below VCC- to 0.1 V above VCC+, and the output swings to within 40 mV of either rail into 10 kΩ (150 mV into 600 Ω). Input bias current is 1 pA typical. A resistor in series with each input keeps the input current within the 10 mA maximum.
ST publishes a macromodel of the TSV99x. It reproduces the typical device inside the specified operating conditions, trading some accuracy for simulation speed.
The DFN8 2x2 exposed pad has no internal connection; it may go to ground or be left floating.

Order codes with Y after the I are automotive grade: qualified and characterised to AEC-Q100 and Q003 or equivalent, screened to AEC-Q001 and Q002 or equivalent. Every package is JEDEC J-STD-020-C moisture sensitivity level 1 except SO14, which is level 3.
